department: Faculty of Engineering — Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Main Round and Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) deadline for 2027-28 entry is December 1, 2026 (1st Clearing Round: April 30, 2027; 2nd Clearing Round: August 31, 2027).
deadline.quote: September 1, 2026 - December 1, 2026 (HKT 23:59 or GMT +8 hours) | The submission deadline for HKPFS applications in 2027-28 is December 1, 2026.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for electrical and computer engineering (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Faculty of Engineering instructs MPhil/PhD applicants to search for potential supervisors and discuss proposed research areas before submitting an application.
supervisor.quote: Search for potential supervisor(s) (contact details and brief introduction of teaching staff are also available in the departmental websites). | Discuss the proposed research areas with the potential supervisor(s) before submitting application.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students with 2:1 honours (or equivalent) or above are normally eligible for Postgraduate Scholarships (HK$19,135/month; HK$19,655/month after probation confirmation), subject to funding availability, plus HKU-PS/HKPF awards waiving HK$47,000-HK$49,500 composition fees.
funding.quote: other full-time PhD and MPhil students who hold a first degree with second-class honours first division (or equivalent) or above are normally considered eligible to receive a Postgraduate Scholarship (PGS) during the normative study period, subject to availability of funding. | The basic level of scholarship is HK$19,135 per month (wef 1/9/2026).

also.quote: Various scholarships and fellowships are available to our research students: | HKU Presidential PhD Scholar Programme (HKU-PS) | Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPF) | Postgraduate Scholarships (PGS)

entry_route.value: Honours bachelor's and/or taught master's holders are normally considered for the 4-year PhD; research master's holders enter the 3-year PhD.
entry_route.quote: Students who hold a Bachelor’s degree with honours and/or a taught Master’s degree will normally be considered for admission to a 4-year PhD programme. Students who hold a research Master’s degree will be admitted to a 3-year PhD programme.

notes: Renamed from Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE) to Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) in February 2026; also offers departmental conference support grants and Clean Energy scholarships.
